purpose: Evaluate the 10,000 operations per second and p99 below 50 ms acceptance target on paid AWS infrastructure.
pre_run_steps: Completed the 1,000 operations per second control run with zero logical errors.
Kept synchronous_commit enabled to preserve ledger durability.
Configured a 90 connection OLTP application budget split into 74 foreground, 2 transfer, and 14 publisher connections.
Configured a separate 20 connection projection database pool used by 4 aggregate workers.
Configured posting batches of 64 with 4 workers and a 500 microsecond collection window.
Configured transfer batches of 100 with 1 worker.
Configured 16 asynchronous publisher workers with 256 maximum pending acknowledgements.
Configured aggregate batches of 64 with 4 workers.
Enabled CPU and heap profiling and database-statistics snapshots.
Ran a 15 second warm-up followed by a 30 second measured test at 10,000 requested operations per second.
